  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Maui, Hawaii - Winter 2026</h3><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><a href="https://app.acuityscheduling.com/catalog.php?owner=19868404&amp;action=addCart&amp;clear=1&amp;id=2232310" target="_blank"><strong>RESERVE HERE</strong></a></h3><h3 2026</p></li></ul><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><span style="text-decoration:underline">Cost:</span></h3><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">$5,000 per private room</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">7 Days / 6 Nights</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Add a second guest to the same room for $1,000</p></li></ul><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><span style="text-decoration:underline">What's Included:</span></h3><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">7 days / 6 nights in premium <strong>private oceanfront accommodations</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Private bedroom with king or queen bed (unless sharing by choice)</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Direct beach access just steps from your room</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Airport transportation upon arrival and departure</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Daily coaching and guided sessions tailored to your skill level</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Small-group environment for maximum progression and personalized feedback</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Two Professional chef-prepared meals provided daily</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Daily yoga and mobility sessions</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Post-session recovery with hot tub access and ocean views</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Access to multiple disciplines, including:</p></li><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Kiteboarding</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Wing Foiling</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Surfing</p></li></ul></ul><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><span
